title: Climbing SOLO with Alex Honnold   **INSANE EXPERIENCE**
summary: Norwegian climber Magnus Midtbo spends a day climbing with Alex Honnold on exposed routes, shot as a vlog. The video shows the stark contrast between Midtbo's visible nerves and Honnold's calm.
why: Recommended for conveying viscerally just how exceptional Honnold's composure is compared to other elite climbers.
